name: The Wren
description: A small hotel on a quiet side street, a ten-minute walk from the welcome drinks. Most of our family is staying here, and the shuttle leaves from the front door.

name: Catskill Mill Inn
description: A converted paper mill on Catskill Creek, with big windows, a good breakfast and a short drive to the falls. The shuttle stops here too.

name: Rhinebeck Commons Motor Lodge
description: A cheerful, renovated motor lodge with a pool and fire pits. The easiest option if you're driving up from the city, but you'll need your own car on the day.
